clips.title: The story
paras: Brill Town Hall is the administrative heart of the settlement of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Standing as the most prominent structure in town, it serves as the civic headquarters from which the Forsaken govern their local holdings and coordinate the defense of the glades.

While much of Lordaeron lies shattered and ruined, Brill Town Hall remains standing as a functioning civic center under undead rule. Inside, Magistrate Sevren directs town affairs from his podium, handing out vital commissions and directives to Forsaken adventurers. Aside from the Defiler's Den in the Arathi Highlands, it is one of the only recognized town halls in the known world actively run by the Forsaken, serving as a bleak parody and functional continuation of old Lordaeron's municipal bureaucracy.
